backend/main.mo: Main canister actor defining authorization, invite link state, user profiles, pairing and phone verification types, and activity/location/schedule/filter structures with migration applied on upgrade.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to new format by extending audit logs and adding pending pairing requests.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two new UI features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of frontend file summaries describing functionality, recent feature changes, and polling or i18n updates.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining theme tokens for light and dark modes and applying global background, text, and border styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the React app, meta tags, manifest, and icons for the Parental Control PWA.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, categories, and startup configuration.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing asset caching, cache cleanup, fetch fallback, and background sync for queued location updates.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication, profile setup, role-based routing, and the unauthenticated landing page layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Renders an admin table of user accounts with role labels and actions to disable or enable accounts.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Provides a password gate for admin access with tabs for verifying and changing the admin password.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Displays metric cards summarizing total users, parents, children, and pairings.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child user's daily activity status, alerts for limit overages, and a request-more-time input.
Shows a parent's view of a child's daily activity usage with alerts and a summary panel.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Displays a sortable audit log table showing actions, executor principals, and timestamps for a child.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: A login/logout button that triggers Internet Identity authentication, handles edge cases, and updates query and admin state. UI switches between login, logout, and loading states.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: A modal form for creating a user profile with name, role, and optional validated phone number. Submits the profile via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Fetches and displays a child's activity history in a sortable table. Shows loading, empty states, and an optional transparency badge.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Provides forms for children to submit activities and locations, and to toggle live location sharing. Handles geolocation, validation, and backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Renders a consent notice for activity, location, or pairing actions with icon, title, and description. Uses i18n strings for content.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Fetches and displays a child's location history in a sortable table. Supports loading, empty states, and an optional transparency label.
frontend/src/components/child/PairWithPa: Allows children to pair with a parent using a code or phone number, with validation, polling, and success error handling. Auto-fills codes from URL parameters.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Loads and edits a child’s content filter settings including categories and allow/block lists. Persists updates via a mutation hook and shows an informational notice.
Displays a read-only content filter with categories, allowlist, and blocklist for a child account.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Provides a dropdown to switch app languages using the i18n hook.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Renders the app footer with copyright, policy link, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Shows the app header with logo, user info, theme toggle, language selector, and login button.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Displays an activity history list for a child with a consent notice.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Shows a child's summary card with recent activity, locations, and selection state.
frontend/src/components/parent/LiveLocat: Shows latest shared location on a map with timestamps, live status, and fallback states.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Provides tabs for viewing a child's live map or location history with a consent notice.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: Generates and displays a pairing code with warnings and copy support.
frontend/src/components/parent/ParentPho: Displays and edits the parent's stored phone number with validation and profile update logic.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Provides an interface to edit a child's daily screen-time limit and allowed time windows and save them to the backend.
Shows a read-only view of a child's configured daily limit and allowed time windows.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Tracks whether an admin gate has been passed using sessionStorage and exposes pass/clear functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Returns the i18n context to access translations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication via Internet Identity, exposing identity state, login, and logout logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveLocationSharin: Continuously captures and submits geolocation updates, queues failed submissions, and handles background sync and permissions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin status, parent/child relationships, activities, locations, and related data via an ICP actor.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Implements an i18n context provider that stores language preference, loads translations, and exposes a translation function.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports supported locales and aggregates translation dictionaries for English and Portuguese.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: Contains the English translation strings for the app UI.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Contains the Brazilian Portuguese translation strings for the app UI.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS setup and custom CSS variables for light/dark navy-themed color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/leafletMarkerIcon.ts: Empty placeholder file, likely intended for Leaflet marker icon configuration.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard showing user accounts, parent-child links, and aggregated metrics using tabbed UI components.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Child home screen displaying check-in, history, schedule, filters, alerts, and pairing status with a parent.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard providing child management, pairing requests, activity/location views, scheduling, filters, and alerts.
Renders a modal page displaying transparency and data‑usage policies using translated text and UI components.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers the service worker and exposes helpers for background and periodic sync capabilities.
frontend/src/utils/liveLocationCapabilit: Detects device and PWA capabilities for geolocation and background updates, returning status and user messages.
frontend/src/utils/locationUpdateQueue.t: LocalStorage-backed queue for storing and retrying batched location updates with size and retry limits.
frontend/src/utils/phoneNumber.ts: Utility functions for normalizing, validating, parsing, and formatting 11‑digit phone numbers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, supporting both query strings and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended color palette using CSS variables, custom fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project state for a parent/child app, tracking existing features and pending requests for an in-app parent confirmation flow.
